name: CapturePro Mirrorless Pro-X
description: The CapturePro Pro-X redefines what's possible in a mirrorless camera. At its core is a groundbreaking 50.1MP stacked full-frame sensor, delivering unprecedented speed and image quality. This camera achieves blackout-free continuous shooting at up to 30fps with full AF/AE tracking, making it a powerhouse for sports and wildlife. The advanced AI-powered autofocus system offers real-time tracking for human, animal, and bird eyes with astonishing precision. For filmmakers, the Pro-X is a dream, recording breathtaking 8K video at 30fps and 4K at 120fps in 10-bit color, offering immense creative flexibility in post-production. The rugged, weather-sealed body is complemented by a 9.44M-dot OLED electronic viewfinder that provides a viewing experience indistinguishable from an optical one. This is the ultimate hybrid camera, built without compromise for top-tier professionals who operate at the intersection of photography and cinematography. The Pro-X is not just a tool; it's an extension of creative ambition. Features: 50.1MP Stacked Full-Frame CMOS Sensor, 30fps Blackout-Free Continuous Shooting, 8K 30p and 4K 120p 10-bit Video, AI-Based Real-time Tracking AF, 9.44M-Dot High-Resolution EVF. Advantages: Blazing fast performance for stills and video; Class-leading autofocus system; Incredible detail from the high-resolution sensor. Considerations: High price point and expensive memory cards; Generates large file sizes requiring significant storage. Best for: Top-level professional photographers and videographers who require the absolute best in speed, resolution, and performance.
